sloka: अयम् स कालः संप्राप्तः प्रियो यः ते प्रियंवद ।अलंकृत इव आभाति येन संवत्सरः शुभः ॥३-१६-४॥
transliteration: ayam sa kālaḥ saṁprāptaḥ priyo yaḥ te priyaṁvada ।alaṁkṛta iva ābhāti yena saṁvatsaraḥ śubhaḥ ॥3-16-4॥

translations.english: O sweetspeaking brother, the season which is dear to you has arrived. It appears the auspicious year is going to be embellished with this season.
